entities.summary: The Met Office Hadley Centre — named in honour of George Hadley — is one of the United Kingdom's leading centres for the study of scientific issues associated with climate change. It is part of, and based at the headquarters of the Met Office in Exeter. Met Office Hadley Centre is a research institute in Europe, established in 1990. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
